title: [CQ-M07o] JetBrains Start Agent routes worker/QA seats to a Moe VM under verified-local
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8); M07 DoD 1-3 on the JetBrains side. Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation. JetBrains is the primary IDE and goes first; VS Code follows in CQ-M07p. Depends on CQ-M07d (task-b0485bb1) for GET_EXECUTION_READINESS.

Objective: under verified-local, Start Agent and Start Agents for a worker or QA seat either launch that seat's wrapper on the VM route or refuse before any terminal opens. Architect and governor seats stay on the host, unchanged.

Deliverable, in moe-jetbrains (util/TerminalAgentLauncher.kt resolveContext, launchRole, startAgent and startAgents, plus a pure decision helper and its JUnit tests):
- Profile absent, legacy or observe (read as util/RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt does today): byte-for-byte today's commands for all four roles, WSL toggle on or off, Windows or not.
- verified-local, worker or QA: send GET_EXECUTION_READINESS { refresh: true } over /ws and wait a bounded time for EXECUTION_READINESS.
  - Not ready, daemon not connected, or no reply in time: a dialog naming each missing capability (or the connection failure). No terminal, no VM, no host fallback.
  - Ready: launch the protected wrapper. On Windows, ALWAYS the native PowerShell wrapper, even with "Run Agents in WSL" on (human decision: the pinned Multipass client runs on Windows). Architect and governor keep honoring the WSL toggle.
  - An agent CLI other than claude or codex (the guest JOBS table: gemini, grok, a custom command) is refused with a dialog naming it.
- The plugin never runs Multipass, never provisions and never starts the agent CLI itself: the wrapper's VM route (CQ-M07m/n) does that.
- CLIENT_HELLO declares capabilities.verifiedLocal true.

NOT in scope: the wrapper's VM route; VS Code (CQ-M07p); the Accounts tab (CQ-M07l); docs (CQ-M07 sweep).

Verification: ./gradlew test under the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease), from WSL: cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun", or a snapshot run of the exact commit (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gate-snapshot).
definitionOfDone: Profile absent, legacy or observe: the launch command for every role equals today's output, WSL toggle on and off (JUnit table pinned to current output).
verified-local and ready: worker and QA launch the native PowerShell wrapper on Windows even with the WSL toggle on, while architect and governor commands are unchanged (JUnit on the pure decision).

verified-local and not ready, no daemon, or no reply in time: the decision is a refusal carrying the missing capability list, and no terminal widget is created (JUnit on the decision plus the launcher with a fake terminal manager).
verified-local with agentCommand gemini, grok or a custom command: refused, naming the CLI (JUnit).
CLIENT_HELLO carries verifiedLocal true (JUnit on the hello payload).
taskRails: Never fall back to a host or WSL launch of a worker/QA agent CLI under verified-local; refuse instead.
